# Berkeley ranked No. 1 public university by US News
_UC Berkeley is Number 1 in the latest U.S. News & World Report rankings of public national universities, claiming the top position for the 17th straight year. The rankings were released today._
By [Public Affairs](https://news.berkeley.edu/author/pa/)
Sather Tower
September 9, 2014
rankings250 UC Berkeley is No. 1 in the latest _U.S. News & World Report_ rankings of public national universities, claiming the top position for the 17th straight year.
And once again, UCLA and Virginia were second among public universities in the 2015 college rankings, which were released today (Tuesday, Sept. 9). The University of Michigan and the University of North Carolina-Chapel Hill rounded out the top five.

...

Among all universities, Berkeley again placed 20th overall. Princeton repeated as the top ranked college, followed by Harvard (2nd), Yale (3rd), and Columbia, Chicago and Stanford (tied at 4th). MIT placed 7th.
Berkeley’s tuition and fees were by far the lowest of any college in the top 10.

...

According to _U.S. News & World Report_ , the overall campus rankings are based on a formula that “uses quantitative measures that education experts have proposed as reliable indicators of academic quality, and it’s based on our researched view of what matters in education.”
